title: Oracle November 2026 Critical Security Patch Update fixes hundreds of flaws including Java4Shell
what_changed: Summary said 'about 300 unauthenticated and remotely exploitable and 62 critical' (CVEs) and attributed 655 to Oracle's advisory; SecurityWeek says 'just over 300 patches' and 62 patches, and that Oracle makes no mention of exploitation (not that none is reported). Oracle's page returned 403 to the reviewer.
